notes.title: Hidden Arcade - Update V1.2.0
notes.content:
Heyo! This is a rather small update, but I got some feedback, felt productive and put it together today. :D

Quality of Life:

 Timer Popup: In the game, in all three levels, there is a timer in the top left corner, and at the end of the level, you are put up against everyone else globally in a list, consider it a "speedrun timer". Now, there has always been the option to disable it in the Setting in the Main Menu, but for players who would not know that the timer was auto-enabled, it could feel as if they were not in full control of whether or not their data should be stored, and whether the timer is active. For that reason, for anyone new starting the game, or any other player who never made a conscious choice before, there is a one-time popup when you start the game now, asking for your preference.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013671/fcbeb47f9517d5ac782229c9024d16cd79c853fb.png
 Permanent Progress Saving: Not everyone wants to complete an entire level in one sitting, I get that. For that reason, your progress - the time you took, the Ghosts you've clicked, the score you have - now gets permanently saved for all 3 main levels whenever you exit them via the Home Button, and it gets reloaded when you enter them again! But don't fret - if you want to restart a level to improve your time, imply play it till the end, and either click on [Restart] or [Back to Hub] or [Exit Game] to get rid of your progress and be able to restart! :)


I got caught up so much in trying to innovate on the genre that I got carried away and forgot about people who don't want that, as they are happy with how the genre goes. Overall, I think these are additions that should be welcome to everyone, and I hope yall enjoy them. :)

notes.title: What does the future look like for Hidden Arcade?
notes.content:
ːluvː Heyo! I wanted to talk a bit about the future of the game! ːLIS_pixel_heartː

We're very excited that the launch of the game went so incredibly well!
We're overwhelmed by the positive feedback and have decided that it is most definitely worth it to put more time and effort into the game! Thank you very much to anyone who has played the game, or even reviewed it, or even created a custom level!

How about updates and patches?

First off, I am very engaged and dedicated to providing updates and patches to any issues that might still exist! My goal is to put out one update / patch a week.
The only issue I am currently aware of seems to be that sometimes, the Steam Workshop back-end for uploading and downloading user created levels acts up, and as this has already been a major focus in past updates, it will continue to be in future ones so that it works on any machine, with any internet speed!
The reason for this is that it is the hardest feature to test for how it is going to be for others. There are only so many simulated conditions I can create (smurf Steam account, throttle Upload / Download speed), and beyond that, it is up to see what people experience. But I also want you to know that currently, your created levels are safe! Even if you cannot upload them, you can save them locally and upload them later.

How do you go on now?

Since the game is free, I sadly had to think of some kind of method to generate a little bit of money to justify further development. BUT - I wanted it to be very non-intrusive and light, so that everyone can access the full game without having to pay anything.
So, what I came up with for now is that there is an extended ultimate Soundtrack that you can get for a buck, and it has about 20 minutes of songs from both the games in our Ghostly Arcade franchise, extended, mixed for your enjoyment, and it even has one track that is currently unreleased.

Additionally, you can get a bundle of the Soundtrack as well as Haunted Arcade for LESS MONEY THAN HAUNTED ARCADE ON ITS OWN.
THat's right. Time for aggressive marketing xd

How about more content in the future?

Good news! My partner and I have been looking at the reception, considering our options, and she has decided that she would like to make more art for the other Arcade Games!
So you can expect a DLC in the future containing Levels for Laser Bike, Robot Time, Defenders of Plushville and Sheepy Runs!
This content will guaranteed be available within the coming 2 and a half months, as it is also very light on coding, and also, after that, the next semester starts again.

How about final words?

Again, thank you all so much, and we hope you keep engaging and having fun with the game! See ya! 💗

notes.title: Hidden Arcade - Day 3 Patch
notes.content:
Day 3 Patch:

Bugfixes:

 Custom Player: Previously, when subscribing to custom maps, you had to either refresh multiple times or leave and enter the Custom Player machine again for the newly downloaded map to work - now, you can just refresh once and it will (/should) work.
 Custom Player: Playing a map, then loading another one will now properly reset the timer, reset the score to 0, and put all the Ghosts back where they belong, and scale them regularly again.
 Custom Player / Creator: In the custom maps, the Magnifgying Glass button sometimes took the camera to a random empty spot - no more! :) 
 Hub Area: Previously, if you disabled the speedrun timer, the toggle would not remember that. It would still be turned off in-game, but the toggle thought it is on again. No longer! :)


Day 2 Update:

Quality of Life:

 Any Level: Additional UI elements like the home button, black-and-white toggle and the info icon will toggle off after a few seconds. You can toggle them on and off anytime using the escape key. This will prevent accidentally hitting the home button or b-w toggle.
 Any Level: Moving the image using either your mouse or WASD is now more dependent on the zoom level - the closer you're zoomed in, the less distance it covers. This prevents disorienting dragging.


2nd Day 1 Patch Notes:

Bugfixes:

 Custom Creator: Ghost images now get saved properly.
 Custom Creator: Ghost positions now get saved properly.
 Custom Creator / Custom Player: Uploading and downloading custom levels should now work fluently.


Day 1 Patch Notes:

Bugfixes:

 All Levels: Fixed Leaderboard entries - displays you on top for now, then the 9 people worse than you.
 Custom Creator: Loading / selecting pre-existing levels refreshes properly.


Quality of Life:

 All Levels: Added tool-tip for magnifying tool when hovered over.
 All Levels: Added info i to level that shows / explains controls when hovered over.
 All Levels: Changed tool-tip background textures for all Custom Creator buttons and adjusted colors.
 Custom Creator / Custom Player: Moved background texture to load in first to give clearer sign of progression.
 Custom Creator / Custom Player: Made it so that all Ghosts exchange their texture at once instead one after the other.


Day 0 Patch Notes:

Bugfixes:

 Main Menu: Fixed the very glaringly obvious bug of clicks causing either the settings menu to open or the application to close.
 Custom Player: Fixed copying and loading custom Ghost textures properly.
 All Levels: Fixed clamping the magnifying-tool-usage properly into image.


Quality of Life:

 Custom Creator: Added button to batch change all Ghost textures at once.
 Custom Creator: Added unique ID to user created levels that deals with multiple levels having the same name.
 Custom Creator / Custom Player: Added Ghost animation for texture exchange.
